context:
Goal: the Orphaned candidates read clearly on the phone at every text size.
Problem (rule): the line with the date, the untracked tag and the order id wraps at large text on the phone; the web keeps it on one line. One line with shrink-to-fit still made Apple's audit call it clipped (measured 2026-10-27). The debt closes only on your ruling or on a one-line version that passes.
Based on (measured): the 2026-10-27 audit run on OrphanedView.
Based on (read): OrphanedView.swift:406 still shrinks the seller to half size before it truncates.
Departs from: OrphanedView.swift:CandidateRow — the web keeps the meta line on one line; option a lets it wrap on the phone.
Meanwhile: the phone ships the wrapping line.

options.gain: Every word stays readable, and the audit passes.
options.how: The meta line wraps at large text, and the debt closes.
options.label: Wrapping is right on the phone
options.lose: Candidate rows get taller at large text, unlike the web.

options.how: A lane tries other one-line layouts until one passes the audit.
options.label: Keep looking for a one-line version
options.lose: More test rounds, and no one-line version has passed yet.

ref: debt native-candidate-lines-wrap (the candidate meta line wraps); decision orphaned-colours-by-meaning
title: On the phone, a candidate's date and order line wraps at large text. Is wrapping right?
why: The audit reads all the text only when it wraps, and large text is where readability matters most.
